model_inputs.readback_basis: Point observations at 1 January of each calendar year, not parameter changes or complete annual schedules. Inputs that preserve calendar dates, including statutory forecast gaps, can change later in the year.

earnings.source: Table 1.6 Labour market, Average weekly earnings growth (per cent) (calendar year)

non_labour_income.source: Table 1.12 Household disposable income (£ billion current prices, seasonally adjusted), Non-labour income (growth in the calendar-year level)

house_prices.source: Table 1.16 Housing market, House price index (per cent change on a year earlier) (calendar year)

rent.source: Table 1.7 Inflation, Actual rents for housing (calendar year)

mortgage_interest.source: Table 1.7 Inflation, Mortgage interest payments (calendar year); 2030 kept at the pre-Budget value: the OBR does not forecast mortgage interest payments that far

cpi_ahc.source: Native policyengine-uk 2.174.1: create_ahc_deflator on the OBR's CPI and actual rents (Table 1.7) and Ofwat water bills (not an OBR series)

social_rent.source: Native policyengine-uk 2.174.1: England social rent policy cap, previous September CPI + 1 percentage point. Published September outturns and native statutory September CPI forecasts from OBR receipts Table 4.19; not an OBR-published social rent series.
